paragraphs: Proofpoint sells email security software that organizations deploy either through an API or through a secure email gateway. Core Email Protection is the email product on that page, described as blocking 99.999% of advanced email threats, including phishing attacks, BEC, and ransomware.

Collaboration Security Prime extends that protection beyond email to messaging and collaboration tools, cloud applications, and the supply chain on one platform. Email Fraud Defense is a separate product built on DMARC authentication, domain discovery, and supplier risk visibility through Supplier Risk Explorer.

The homepage and the email protection page name customers including Accenture, Wyndham, Goosehead Insurance, and Perrigo. A By Industry menu on those pages lists Federal Government, State and Local Government, Higher Education, and Healthcare.

quote.text: Email is today's most important business communications channel. It's also organizations' No. 1 threat vector.
